description: Compass plugin hooks. PostToolUse runs `compass sync` (a command, not an agent) on any vault write to regenerate index.md and the tag index off the agent's token budget. The CLI parses the hook's stdin JSON, self-filters its own generated outputs to avoid a write loop, and never exits 2 (which would block the user's edit). The entry is split three ways (Write, Edit, MultiEdit) because the `if` clause does not support `||` boolean OR; each entry has its own permission-rule pattern. Stop fires extract-lessons and SubagentStop captures subagent reports - these remain agent-type because they involve judgment, not mechanical bookkeeping.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" sync --hook; else python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" sync --hook; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" sync --hook; else python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" sync --hook; fi

hooks.prompt: The main agent just ended a turn. Check whether a phase boundary completed outside /compass:build. Algorithm: glob .compass/tmp/phase-reports/*/ for any directory containing a phase-summary.yaml file but no .processed marker file. If none found, exit silently with 'no-op: no unprocessed phases'. If one or more found, for the most recently modified one, invoke the extract-lessons skill with that directory path as argument. The extract-lessons skill writes the .processed marker itself, providing the mutex against double-firing with the /compass:build primary path.

A Compass subagent just stopped. The hook input includes 'agent_type' (e.g. 'builder', 'tester') and 'last_assistant_message' (the final assistant message text from the subagent). Write the last_assistant_message verbatim as the body of a file at .compass/tmp/subagent-captures/<UTC_timestamp>_<agent_type>.md. The UTC_timestamp format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS. Create the .compass/tmp/subagent-captures/ directory if it does not exist. Prepend this YAML frontmatter to the file:

---
type: subagent_capture
agent_type: <agent_type>
agent_id: <agent_id from input>
captured_at: <ISO-8601 timestamp>
---

This is purely mechanical capture - do not summarize or transform the message. The /compass:build skill at phase end will move these captures into .compass/tmp/phase-reports/<phase-id>/ with task-specific names.
